Annotation.String: The `UpdateServiceCapabilities` schema contains capabilities of the update service.
This resource shall represent the update service capabilities for a Redfish implementation.
The allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for update requests.
This property shall contain an array of the allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for `SimpleUpdate` or `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.
The allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for update requests when requesting to stage an image on target devices.

This property shall contain an array of the allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for `SimpleUpdate` or `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests with `Stage` set to `true`.

The types of URI references that the service accepts in the `Targets` and parameter for update requests.

This property shall contain an array that indicates the types of URI references that the service accepts as valid values in the `Targets` parameter for `SimpleUpdate` or `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests. If this property is not present, the `AllowableTargets` property contains the exact set of URIs that are allowed in the `Targets` parameter.
